            measured = self._measured_source_s
        else:
            current = _finite(receive_s)
            measured = self._measured_receive_s
        if current is None:
            return None, "current_invalid"
        if measured is None:
            return None, None
        return current - measured, None

    def note_epoch(self, time_epoch):
        """A changed source epoch is a clock reset: history clears, lock is lost."""
        if self.time_epoch is not None and time_epoch != self.time_epoch:
            self.track_status = "lost"
            self.position_predicted = True
            self.requires_reselection = True
            self._reset_history("time_epoch_changed")
        self.time_epoch = int(time_epoch)

    def select(self, track_id, time_epoch, candidate=None, position_m=None,
               calibration_version=None, selection_version=None,
               source_stamp_s=None, receive_s=None):
        """Lock one operator-chosen candidate (or explicit position) in the session."""
        if track_id is None:
            raise ValueError("track_id is required to lock a target")
        if candidate is not None:
            view = candidate_view(candidate)
            position = view["position_m"]
            self.candidate_id = view["candidate_id"]
        else:
            position = position_m
            self.candidate_id = None
        if position is None:
            raise ValueError("select needs a candidate or an explicit position_m")
        array = np.asarray(position, dtype=np.float64)
        if array.shape != (3,) or not np.all(np.isfinite(array)):
            raise ValueError("position_m must be three finite numbers")
        self.note_epoch(time_epoch)
        self.track_id = track_id
        self.track_status = "locked"
        self.position_m = [float(value) for value in array]
        self.velocity_m_s = None
        self.position_predicted = False
        self.requires_reselection = False
        self.calibration_version = calibration_version
        if selection_version is not None:
            self.selection_version = int(selection_version)
        self._measured_position = array.tolist()
        self._measured_source_s = _finite(source_stamp_s)
        self._measured_receive_s = _finite(receive_s)
        if self._measured_receive_s is not None:
            self.time_domain = "time_received_s"
        elif self._measured_source_s is not None:
            self.time_domain = "source_stamp_s"
        else:
            self.time_domain = None
        self.clock_reason = None
        self._occluded_since = None
        self._prediction_age_s = None
        self._reset_history("operator_select")
        self.action_history.append({"type": "observed", "source_stamp_s": self._measured_source_s})
        return self.snapshot()

    def release(self, reason="operator_release"):
        self.track_id = None
        self.candidate_id = None
        self.track_status = "unselected"
        self.position_m = None
        self.velocity_m_s = None
        self.position_predicted = False
        self.requires_reselection = False
        self._measured_position = None
        self._measured_source_s = None
        self._measured_receive_s = None
        self._occluded_since = None
        self._prediction_age_s = None
        self.time_domain = None
        self.clock_reason = None
        self._reset_history(reason)
        return self.snapshot()

    def _go_lost(self, reason, source_stamp_s=None, receive_s=None):
        self.track_status = "lost"
        self.position_predicted = True
        self.requires_reselection = True
        self._prediction_age_s = None
        self._reset_history(reason)
        if source_stamp_s is not None:
            self._measured_source_s = _finite(source_stamp_s)
        if receive_s is not None:
            self._measured_receive_s = _finite(receive_s)
        return self.snapshot()

    def update(self, candidates, time_epoch, source_stamp_s=None, receive_s=None):
        """Feed one candidate frame; returns the track state after the update."""
        self.note_epoch(time_epoch)
        if self.track_status not in ("locked", "occluded"):
            return self.snapshot()
        if self.track_id is None:
            return self.snapshot()

        elapsed, invalid = self._elapsed(source_stamp_s, receive_s)
        if invalid is not None:
            return self._reject_current(invalid)
        if elapsed is not None:
            if elapsed < 0.0:
                return self._go_lost("clock_regressed", source_stamp_s, receive_s)
            if elapsed > self.settings["lost_timeout_s"]:
                return self._go_lost("lost_timeout", source_stamp_s, receive_s)

        dt = 0.0 if elapsed is None else elapsed
        predicted = self._predict(dt)
        track = {"track_id": self.track_id, "position_m": predicted.tolist(), "size_m": None}
        views = [candidate_view(candidate) for candidate in candidates]
        views = [view for view in views if view["position_m"] is not None]
        association = associate_tracks([track], views, dt, self._assoc_settings())

        if association["matches"]:
            match = association["matches"][0]
            measured = next(view["position_m"] for view in views
                            if view["candidate_id"] == match["candidate_id"])
            self._apply_measured(measured, dt, source_stamp_s, receive_s)
            self.candidate_id = match["candidate_id"]
            return self.snapshot()

        if self.track_id in association["ambiguous_track_ids"]:
            self.track_status = "ambiguous"
            self.position_m = predicted.tolist()
            self.position_predicted = True
            self.requires_reselection = True
            self._prediction_age_s = dt
            self._reset_history("ambiguous")
            return self.snapshot()

        now = _finite(receive_s)
        if now is None:
            now = _finite(source_stamp_s)
        if self._occluded_since is None:
            self._occluded_since = now
        self.position_predicted = True
        self.position_m = predicted.tolist()
        # A predicted position is as old as its last measured anchor, including
        # any gap before the first missing frame was reported.
        self._prediction_age_s = dt
        self.track_status = "occluded"
        return self.snapshot()

    def _reject_current(self, reason):
        """Refuse the current frame's timing without consuming a measurement.

        The last valid measured baseline is kept and the position is reported as
        predicted; the clock domain is never switched to manufacture a valid dt.
        """
        self.track_status = "occluded"
        self.position_predicted = True
        self.position_m = self._predict(0.0).tolist()
        self.clock_reason = reason
        return self.snapshot()

    def _predict(self, dt):
        """Prediction anchored at the last measurement (never re-integrated)."""
        if self._measured_position is None:
            return np.asarray(self.position_m, dtype=np.float64)
        anchor = np.asarray(self._measured_position, dtype=np.float64)
        if self.velocity_m_s is not None:
            return anchor + np.asarray(self.velocity_m_s, dtype=np.float64) * max(0.0, dt)
        return anchor

    def _apply_measured(self, measured, dt, source_stamp_s, receive_s):
        measured = np.asarray(measured, dtype=np.float64)
        previous = np.asarray(self._measured_position, dtype=np.float64)
        if dt > 0.0:
            raw = (measured - previous) / dt
            speed = float(np.linalg.norm(raw))
            if speed > self.settings["max_speed_m_s"]:
                raw = raw * (self.settings["max_speed_m_s"] / speed)
            smoothing = self.settings["velocity_smoothing"]
            if self.velocity_m_s is None:
                self.velocity_m_s = raw.tolist()
            else:
                blended = (1.0 - smoothing) * np.asarray(self.velocity_m_s) + smoothing * raw
                self.velocity_m_s = blended.tolist()
        self.track_status = "locked"
        self.position_m = measured.tolist()
        self.position_predicted = False
        self.requires_reselection = False
        self._measured_position = measured.tolist()
        self._measured_source_s = _finite(source_stamp_s)
        self._measured_receive_s = _finite(receive_s)
        self._occluded_since = None
        self._prediction_age_s = None
        self.action_history.append({"type": "observed",
                                    "source_stamp_s": self._measured_source_s})

    def snapshot(self):
        return {
            "kind": KIND,
            "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
            "session_id": self.session_id,
            "time_epoch": self.time_epoch,
            "track_id": self.track_id,
            "track_status": self.track_status,
            "candidate_id": self.candidate_id,
            "position_m": None if self.position_m is None else list(self.position_m),
            "position_predicted": bool(self.position_predicted),
            "prediction_age_s": self._prediction_age_s,
            "prediction_stale": (self._prediction_age_s is not None
                                 and self._prediction_age_s > self.settings["occlusion_timeout_s"]),
            "velocity_m_s": None if self.velocity_m_s is None else list(self.velocity_m_s),
            "selection_version": self.selection_version,
            "calibration_version": self.calibration_version,
            "requires_reselection": bool(self.requires_reselection),
            "action_generation": self.action_generation,
            "history_reset_reason": self.history_reset_reason,
            "time_domain": self.time_domain,
            "clock_reason": self.clock_reason,
            "last_measured_source_s": self._measured_source_s,
            "last_measured_receive_s": self._measured_receive_s,
        }

2: 
3: Everything here works on arrays and plain dicts so the whole chain can be tested
4: on Windows without ROS; ``scripts/human_fall_node.py`` is only message plumbing

12:   ``core.features``, ``core.fall_state``).

17:   current cloud frame cannot produce a selectable snapshot, and a request that

21:   repeat/reset on the unverified auxiliary stream must not bump the geometry
22:   cloud epoch or invalidate the operator's selection epoch.
23: - A select request bound to an older snapshot is accepted only when the
24:   requested candidate has a **unique continuous match** in the latest valid
25:   snapshot; a disappeared/ambiguous target is rejected rather than locked from
26:   a cached position.
27: - Every observation and baseline sample carries the full binding set
28:   (session/track/epoch/selection/generation/calibration) so the strict
29:   ``baseline_applies`` guard can actually succeed without being relaxed.
30: - Events are JSON-validated before being remembered, so a non-serializable
31:   event can never poison later state publication; a duplicate (already

243: class EventLog:
244:     """Append-only JSONL event store with de-duplication and explicit failure.
245: 
246:     ``append`` returns ``(persisted, reason)``. The event is only remembered
247:     after it passes ``allow_nan=False`` serialization, so a non-JSON value can
248:     never be queued into ``recent`` and break later state publication. The event
249:     is remembered even when the disk write fails (never re-emitted as new), but
250:     the failure is surfaced as ``degraded`` instead of being reported as a save.
251:     Loading an existing file on construction means a restarted node never
252:     replays stored events as fresh ones.
253:     """

255:     def __init__(self, path, recent_size=64):
256:         self.path = path
257:         self.recent = deque(maxlen=max(1, int(recent_size)))
258:         self.ids = set()
259:         self.degraded = False
260:         self.degrade_reason = None
261:         self.written = 0
262:         self._load()
263: 
264:     def _load(self):
265:         if not self.path or not os.path.isfile(self.path):
266:             return
267:         try:
268:             with open(self.path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
269:                 for line in handle:
270:                     line = line.strip()
271:                     if not line:
272:                         continue
273:                     try:
274:                         event = json.loads(line)
275:                     except ValueError:
276:                         continue
277:                     event_id = event.get("event_id")
278:                     if event_id and event_id not in self.ids:
279:                         self.ids.add(event_id)
280:                         self.recent.append(event)
281:                         self.written += 1
282:         except OSError as exc:
283:             self.degraded = True
284:             self.degrade_reason = "event_log_read_failed:{}".format(exc)
285: 
286:     def has(self, event_id):
287:         return event_id is not None and event_id in self.ids
288: 
289:     def append(self, event):
290:         event_id = event.get("event_id")
291:         if event_id is None or event_id in self.ids:
292:             return False, "duplicate"
293:         try:
294:             content = dumps_strict(event)
295:         except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
296:             self.degraded = True
297:             self.degrade_reason = "event_log_not_serializable:{}".format(exc)
298:             return False, self.degrade_reason
299:         self.ids.add(event_id)
300:         self.recent.append(event)
301:         if not self.path:
302:             self.degraded = True
303:             self.degrade_reason = "event_log_path_unset"
304:             return False, self.degrade_reason
305:         try:
306:             directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(self.path))
307:             if directory:
308:                 os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
309:             with open(self.path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
310:                 handle.write(content + "\n")
311:             self.written += 1
312:             return True, None
313:         except OSError as exc:
314:             self.degraded = True
315:             self.degrade_reason = "event_log_write_failed:{}".format(exc)
316:             return False, self.degrade_reason
317: 
318:     def report(self):
319:         return {"path": self.path, "degraded": bool(self.degraded),
320:                 "reason": self.degrade_reason, "persisted_count": self.written,
321:                 "recent_count": len(self.recent)}

366:         # invalidation; the monitor is only meaningful with a frozen transform.
367:         self._ground_derived_id = self._block_id(self.ground_derived)
368:         self.ground_monitor = GroundMonitor() if self.ground_derived else None
369:         self.ground_monitor_report = None
370:         self.ground_lifecycle = []
371:         self.clock_domain = clock_domain if clock_domain in CLOCK_DOMAINS else "monotonic"
372:         self._lock = threading.RLock()
373:         self.tracker = TargetTracker(session_id, sections.get("tracking"))
374:         self.features = FeatureExtractor(session_id, sections.get("features"))
375:         self.fall = FallStateMachine(session_id, sections.get("fall"))
376:         self.baseline = StanceBaselineCollector(session_id, sections.get("baseline"))
377:         self.selection = SelectionBackend(session_id, self.tracker, self.baseline,
378:                                           sections.get("selection"))
379:         self.candidate_settings = sections.get("candidates")
380:         # Required cloud and auxiliary streams live in separate time bases so an
381:         # unverified IMU/device clock reset cannot rewind the geometry epoch.
382:         self.cloud_timebase = TimebaseSession(session_id, self.clock_domain,
383:                                               max_forward_jump_s=max_forward_jump_s)
384:         self.cloud_timebase.register("cloud", cloud_timeout_s, required=True)
385:         self.aux_timebase = TimebaseSession(session_id, self.clock_domain,
386:                                             max_forward_jump_s=max_forward_jump_s)
387:         self.aux_timebase.register("imu", imu_timeout_s, required=False)
388:         self.aux_timebase.register("device", device_timeout_s, required=False)
389:         self.event_log = EventLog(event_path, recent_events)
390:         self.imu_quality = {"messages": 0, "finite": None, "last_receive_s": None}
391:         self.device_quality = {"messages": 0, "last_receive_s": None}
392:         self._last_candidate = None
393:         self._last_snapshot_id = None
394:         self._latest_valid_snapshot = None
395:         self._baseline_request_id = None
396:         self._baseline_status = self.baseline.status
397:         self._last_state = None
398:         self.frame_count = 0
399:         self.invalid_frames = 0

401:     @staticmethod
402:     def _expected_lidar_frame(ground, calibration):
403:         if isinstance(calibration, dict):
404:             frame = (calibration.get("frames") or {}).get("lidar")
405:             if frame:
406:                 return frame
407:         if isinstance(ground, dict):
408:             return ground.get("frame")
409:         return None

411:     @staticmethod
412:     def _block_from_calibration(calibration):
413:         if isinstance(calibration, dict):
414:             block = calibration.get("ground_derived")
415:             if isinstance(block, dict):
416:                 return block
417:         return None
418: 
419:     @staticmethod
420:     def _block_id(block):
421:         if isinstance(block, dict):
422:             return block.get("ground_derived_id")
423:         return None

425:     def _context_version_pair(self):
426:         calibration_id = (self.calibration or {}).get("calibration_id")
427:         return (calibration_id, self._ground_derived_id)
428: 
429:     def _resolve_new_context(self, ground, calibration, ground_derived):
430:         """Validate the requested change first; return the canonical binding.
431: 
432:         Every supported entry shape ends in exactly one call to
433:         :func:`~core.calibration.ground_context_calibration`, so every path
434:         publishes the same canonical calibration/ground/derived records and a
435:         consistent (calibration_id, ground_derived_id) pair. Returns
436:         ``(new_calibration, resolved_ground, resolved_block)`` — the caller
437:         only binds on success.
438:         """
439:         if calibration is not None and (ground is not None
440:                                         or ground_derived is not None):
441:             raise ValueError(
442:                 "a full calibration artifact cannot be combined with "
443:                 "ground/ground_derived arguments; the artifact is already a "
444:                 "complete ground context")
445:         if calibration is not None:
446:             # Full artifact: validated end-to-end (parent ground, transforms/
447:             # verification and the embedded derived block, including the
448:             # cross-record consistency). Nothing partial is adopted.
449:             return validate_geometry_calibration(calibration), None, None
450:         if ground_derived is not None:
451:             if ground is None:
452:                 raise ValueError(
453:                     "a bare ground_derived update is incomplete: supply the "
454:                     "matching parent ground (build a full artifact when the "
455:                     "parent is not at hand)")
456:             expected_frame = self._expected_lidar_frame(ground, self.calibration)
457:             try:
458:                 validate_ground_plane(ground, expected_frame=expected_frame)
459:             except ValueError as exc:
460:                 raise ValueError(
461:                     "invalid accompanying ground record: " + str(exc)) from None
462:             validated_derived = validate_ground_derived(ground_derived)
463:             validate_ground_derived_consistency_guard(ground, validated_derived)
464:             new_calibration = ground_context_calibration(
465:                 ground, validated_derived, parent_calibration=self.calibration,
466:                 fallback_frame=self.expected_frame)
467:             return new_calibration, None, None
468:         if ground is not None:
469:             expected_frame = self._expected_lidar_frame(ground, self.calibration)
470:             try:
471:                 validate_ground_plane(ground, expected_frame=expected_frame)
472:             except ValueError as exc:
473:                 raise ValueError("invalid ground record: " + str(exc)) from None
474:             if self.ground_derived is not None:
475:                 validate_ground_derived_consistency_guard(
476:                     ground, self.ground_derived)
477:             new_calibration = ground_context_calibration(
478:                 ground, self.ground_derived, parent_calibration=self.calibration,
479:                 fallback_frame=self.expected_frame)
480:             return new_calibration, None, None
481:         # No new geometry: re-validate the active context (a same-id reload is
482:         # not a free pass for damage) and re-bind to the canonical artifact.
483:         new_calibration = ground_context_calibration(
484:             self.ground, self.ground_derived,
485:             parent_calibration=self.calibration,
486:             fallback_frame=self.expected_frame)
487:         return new_calibration, None, None
488: 
489:     def apply_ground_context(self, ground=None, calibration=None,
490:                              ground_derived=None):
491:         """Explicit startup/reload boundary for the ground local frame (GL-02).
492: 
493:         Validation runs *completely first* through one path
494:         (:meth:`_resolve_new_context`) so a full artifact, a paired
495:         ground+derived update and a bare ground update all yield exactly one
496:         canonical calibration artifact — the published
497:         ``calibration_id``/``ground_derived_id`` always matches the
498:         ground/derived the core actually consumes. The live context
499:         (``calibration``/``ground``/``ground_derived``/``_ground_derived_id``/
500:         monitor) is then swapped atomically. A bare derived block without its
501:         accompanying parent ground is refused outright (it cannot leave a
502:         live old ground/old id mixed with a new derived transform). Context
503:         validity invalidation keys on ``(calibration_id, ground_derived_id)``:
504:         a legal new version of the same geometry also retires old
505:         baseline/snapshot/request/tracker eligibility, while old events and
506:         the source seq/stamp/epoch semantics are kept. There is deliberately
507:         no generic hot-update framework: this is one explicit boundary.
508:         """
509:         with self._lock:
510:             previous_version, previous_id = self._context_version_pair()
511:             # Validation first, nothing is assigned before it succeeds; the
512:             # returned artifact is canonical and deep-copied from the caller.
513:             new_calibration, _, _ = self._resolve_new_context(
514:                 ground, calibration, ground_derived)
515:             resolved_ground, resolved_block = ground_context_from_calibration(
516:                 new_calibration)
517:             new_id = self._block_id(resolved_block)
518:             new_version = new_calibration.get("calibration_id")
519:             changed = (new_version != previous_version) or (new_id != previous_id)
520:             record = {"kind": "ground_derived_lifecycle",
521:                       "previous_id": previous_id, "ground_derived_id": new_id,
522:                       "previous_calibration_version": previous_version,
523:                       "calibration_version": new_version,
524:                       "changed": bool(changed)}
525:             # Atomic switch: only after validation succeeded; the consumed
526:             # ground/derived come from the same canonical artifact so the
527:             # published id can never disagree with the consumed records.
528:             self.calibration = new_calibration
529:             self.ground, self.ground_derived = resolved_ground, resolved_block
530:             if changed:
531:                 invalidated = ["baseline", "snapshots", "positions", "requests",
532:                                "action_history"]
533:                 self._ground_derived_id = new_id
534:                 self.ground_monitor = GroundMonitor() if resolved_block else None
535:                 self.ground_monitor_report = None
536:                 # An accepted capture belongs to the *old* context. Settle it
537:                 # with its original request binding before the binding is
538:                 # cleared, so a version switch can never silently erase an
539:                 # accepted request without a terminal receipt. This explicit
540:                 # pure API has no ROS reload caller, so the receipt is handed
541:                 # back on the lifecycle record; the existing invalidate below
542:                 # still resets eligibility/caches for the new version.
543:                 baseline_ack = None
544:                 if self.baseline.status == "pending":
545:                     self.baseline._fail("ground_derived_changed")
546:                     baseline_ack = self._baseline_completion_ack()
547:                 # Baseline/selection eligibility for the old frame is retired
548:                 # (its history stays in ``retired``); positions/snapshots/requests
549:                 # and the tracker's own position are all cleared so no stale
550:                 # geometry can be re-published under the new frame. Old events
551:                 # and the source seq/stamp/epoch are preserved.
552:                 self.baseline.invalidate("ground_derived_changed")
553:                 self._baseline_request_id = None
554:                 self._baseline_status = self.baseline.status
555:                 if baseline_ack is not None:
556:                     record["baseline_ack"] = baseline_ack
557:                 self.selection._snapshots.clear()
558:                 self.selection._snapshot_order.clear()
559:                 self.selection._requests.clear()
560:                 self.selection._request_order.clear()
561:                 if self.tracker.track_id is not None:
562:                     self.tracker.release("ground_derived_changed")
563:                 self._latest_valid_snapshot = None
564:                 self._last_snapshot_id = None
565:                 self._last_candidate = None
566:                 self._last_state = None
567:                 record["invalidated"] = invalidated
568:             else:
569:                 # Geometry delta is None but the geometry id may have changed
570:                 # (e.g. re-bound same calibration content under a new version):
571:                 # only the monitor state follows the geometry id.
572:                 if new_id != previous_id:
573:                     self._ground_derived_id = new_id
574:                     self.ground_monitor = GroundMonitor() if resolved_block else None
575:                     self.ground_monitor_report = None
576:             self.ground_lifecycle.append(record)
577:             return record

584:             self.imu_quality["messages"] += 1
585:             self.imu_quality["finite"] = finite
586:             self.imu_quality["last_receive_s"] = finite_or_none(receive_s)

590:             self.aux_timebase.note("device", None, stamp, receive_s, frame_id)

594:     # -- per-frame processing -------------------------------------------------
595: 
596:     def process(self, points, receive_s, *, seq=None, stamp_secs=None,
597:                 stamp_nsecs=None, frame_id=None, now=None):
598:         """Process one decoded cloud frame; returns snapshot/state/event payloads.
599: 
600:         ``points`` is an ``(N,3)`` array or ``None`` for a frame that could not be
601:         decoded. ``now`` is the caller's current clock value; it drives freshness
602:         and the published ``time_received_s``. An invalid stamp or undecodable
603:         frame yields a diagnostic snapshot but is never registered as a valid,
604:         selectable snapshot, and its candidates never reach the tracker/fall
605:         history (the target is reported unobservable/unknown instead).
606:         """
607:         now = finite_or_none(now)
608:         if now is None:
609:             now = finite_or_none(receive_s) or 0.0
610:         receive = finite_or_none(receive_s)
611:         frame = frame_id or self.expected_frame
612:         with self._lock:
613:             note = self.cloud_timebase.note("cloud", seq, (stamp_secs, stamp_nsecs),
614:                                             receive_s, frame)
615:             if note["epoch_reset"]:
616:                 self.selection.set_epoch(self.cloud_timebase.time_epoch)
617:             return self._process_locked(points, receive, now, seq, stamp_secs,
618:                                         stamp_nsecs, frame)
619: 
620:     def _process_locked(self, points, receive, now, seq, stamp_secs, stamp_nsecs,
621:                         frame):
622:         stream = self.cloud_timebase.streams["cloud"]
623:         epoch = self.cloud_timebase.time_epoch
624:         self.frame_count += 1
625:         frame_valid = bool(points is not None and stream.stamp_status != "invalid")
626:         snapshot = None
627:         candidates = []
628:         if points is not None:
629:             snapshot = build_snapshot(
630:                 points, self.candidate_settings, session_id=self.session_id,
631:                 time_epoch=epoch, snapshot_id=self._snapshot_id(seq, receive),
632:                 seq=seq, stamp_secs=stamp_secs, stamp_nsecs=stamp_nsecs,
633:                 source_stamp_s=stream.source_stamp_s, frame_id=frame,
634:                 ground=self.ground, calibration=self.calibration,
635:                 transform=self.transform, background=self.background)
636:             if frame_valid:
637:                 self.selection.register_snapshot(snapshot, receive if receive is not None else now)
638:                 self._last_snapshot_id = snapshot["snapshot_id"]
639:                 self._latest_valid_snapshot = snapshot
640:                 candidates = snapshot["candidates"]
641:             else:
642:                 self.invalid_frames += 1
643:         else:
644:             self.invalid_frames += 1
645: 
646:         if self.ground_monitor is not None:
647:             if frame_valid and points is not None:
648:                 try:
649:                     self.ground_monitor_report = self.ground_monitor.feed(
650:                         points, self.ground_derived)
651:                 except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:  # diagnostics never fatal
652:                     self.ground_monitor.note_invalid()
653:                     self.ground_monitor_report = {
654:                         "status": "unknown", "reason": "monitor_error:" + str(exc)}
655:             else:
656:                 # Stream gap / invalid frame: drop the continuity run and the
657:                 # stored verdict so a stale shift cannot be mistaken for a
658:                 # current one.
659:                 self.ground_monitor.note_invalid()
660:                 self.ground_monitor_report = {"status": "unknown",
661:                                               "reason": "no_current_frame"}
662: 
663:         source_stamp_s = stream.source_stamp_s if frame_valid else None
664:         ground_context_unavailable = self._ground_context_unavailable()
665:         if ground_context_unavailable:
666:             # A degraded/unknown/recalibration ground context invalidates the
667:             # *ground-dependent* chain at the source: the current candidate
668:             # never reaches the tracker/feature extractor/fall machine and the
669:             # tracker's continuous observation run ages (no new measured
670:             # height/geometry), while the tracker state machine itself stays
671:             # intact. Source frames, the tracker identity and old events are
672:             # kept; the ordinary IMU degraded check elsewhere is untouched.
673:             candidates = []
674:         track_state = self.tracker.update(candidates, epoch,
675:                                           source_stamp_s=source_stamp_s,
676:                                           receive_s=receive)
677:         observed = None
678:         # Candidate ids are local to each frame. Only a successful association
679:         # can turn a same-named current candidate into this track's measurement.
680:         if (frame_valid and not ground_context_unavailable
681:                 and track_state["track_status"] == "locked"
682:                 and not track_state["position_predicted"]
683:                 and track_state["candidate_id"] is not None):
684:             for candidate in candidates:
685:                 if candidate["candidate_id"] == track_state["candidate_id"]:
686:                     observed = candidate
687:                     break
688:         if ground_context_unavailable:
689:             # The previous frame's cached candidate must never keep publishing
690:             # position/geometry while the ground context is degraded/unknown.
691:             observed = None
692:             self._last_candidate = None
693:         elif observed is not None:
694:             self._last_candidate = observed
695:         elif not track_state.get("track_id"):
696:             # Released/unselected: drop the cached geometry so a later frame
697:             # cannot keep publishing the previous target's position.
698:             self._last_candidate = None
699: 
700:         baseline_ack = None
701:         if ground_context_unavailable:
702:             # Settle the baseline *before* the feature/fall consumers read it, so
703:             # a pending capture fails (with its terminal ack) and a ready
704:             # eligibility retires on the very frame the ground context is lost,
705:             # never after this frame's consumers already saw it.
706:             baseline_ack = self._cancel_baseline_on_ground_loss()
707:         feature_block = self.features.update({
708:             "candidate": observed,
709:             "track_id": track_state["track_id"],
710:             "track_status": track_state["track_status"],
711:             "position_predicted": track_state["position_predicted"],
712:             "time_epoch": epoch,
713:             "session_id": self.session_id,
714:             "selection_version": track_state["selection_version"],
715:             "action_generation": track_state["action_generation"],
716:             "calibration_version": track_state["calibration_version"],
717:             "source_stamp_s": source_stamp_s,
718:         }, None if ground_context_unavailable else self.baseline.baseline)
719: 
720:         if not ground_context_unavailable:
721:             baseline_ack = self._feed_baseline(observed, track_state,
722:                                                source_stamp_s, receive, epoch)
723: 
724:         fall_block = self.fall.update(feature_block, {
725:             "source_stamp_s": source_stamp_s,
726:             "time_epoch": epoch,
727:             "session_id": self.session_id,
728:             "selection_version": track_state["selection_version"],
729:             "action_generation": track_state["action_generation"],
730:             "calibration_version": track_state["calibration_version"],
731:             "track_id": track_state["track_id"],
732:             "track_status": track_state["track_status"],
733:         }, None if ground_context_unavailable else self.baseline.baseline)
734: 
735:         new_event = fall_block.get("new_event")
736:         if new_event is not None:
737:             persisted, reason = self.event_log.append(new_event)
738:             if reason == "duplicate":
739:                 new_event = None
740: 
741:         state = self._state_payload(now, snapshot, frame_valid, track_state,
742:                                     feature_block, fall_block, observed)
743:         self._last_state = state
744:         return {"snapshot": snapshot, "state": state, "event": new_event,
745:                 "baseline_ack": baseline_ack}
746: 
747:     def _snapshot_id(self, seq, receive):
748:         if seq is not None:
749:             return "seq:{}".format(seq)
750:         return "recv:{:.6f}".format(receive if receive is not None else 0.0)
751: 
752:     def _ground_context_unavailable(self):
753:         """True when this frame's ground context cannot support measurements.
754: 
755:         A ``ground_monitor_report`` of ``degraded`` / ``recalibration_required``
756:         / ``unknown`` (a sustained shift, a breaking plane, or a no-current-frame
757:         stream gap) means the bound ground-derived evidence no longer backs any
758:         *ground-dependent* measurement (height-above-ground, baseline, fall).
759:         Without a derived block the monitor stays out of this: no-ground is a
760:         pre-existing degraded path and must not be forced invalid here.
761:         """
762:         if self.ground_derived is None:
763:             return False
764:         report = self.ground_monitor_report
765:         if not isinstance(report, dict):
766:             return False
767:         return report.get("status") in ("degraded", "recalibration_required",
768:                                         "unknown")
769: 
770:     def _feed_baseline(self, observed, track_state, source_stamp_s, receive, epoch):
771:         if self.baseline.status != "pending":
772:             return None
773:         observation = {
774:             "track_id": track_state["track_id"],
775:             "calibration_version": track_state["calibration_version"],
776:             "ground_relative": bool(observed and observed.get("ground_relative_available")),
777:             "point_count": None if observed is None else observed.get("point_count"),
778:             "height_m": None if observed is None else observed.get("height_m"),
779:             "position_m": None if observed is None else observed.get("center_source_m"),
780:         }
781:         self.baseline.feed(observation, source_stamp_s=source_stamp_s,
782:                            predicted=track_state["position_predicted"],
783:                            occluded=track_state["track_status"] != "locked")
784:         if self.baseline.status != self._baseline_status:
785:             previous = self._baseline_status
786:             self._baseline_status = self.baseline.status
787:             if previous == "pending" and self.baseline.status in ("ready", "failed"):
788:                 return self._baseline_completion_ack()
789:         return None
790: 
791:     def _cancel_baseline_on_ground_loss(self):
792:         """Settle the baseline the moment the ground context fails.
793: 
794:         A pending capture accepted while the monitor was ok must not dangle
795:         once the ground context becomes unknown/degraded/holds the latch: the
796:         in-memory samples collected before the failure are kept as history but
797:         never stitched with later post-recovery samples, and the original
798:         ``request_id`` gets a bounded, terminal ``accepted=False`` ack through
799:         the same ``baseline_ack`` path as a normal completion.
800: 
801:         A *ready* baseline is a ground-relative measurement too, so its
802:         eligibility is retired here as well (the artifact is preserved in
803:         ``retired``; a later same-version recovery must re-capture and can never
804:         reuse the old ready). ``invalidate`` is idempotent once the collector is
805:         idle/empty, so this never retires the same baseline twice or re-emits a
806:         terminal ack. The source-stamp sampling clock is not advanced by this
807:         failure.
808:         """
809:         if self.baseline.status == "pending":
810:             self.baseline._fail("ground_monitor_unavailable")
811:             self._baseline_status = self.baseline.status
812:             return self._baseline_completion_ack()
813:         if self.baseline.status == "ready":
814:             self.baseline.invalidate("ground_monitor_unavailable")
815:             self._baseline_status = self.baseline.status
816:         return None
817: 
818:     def _baseline_completion_ack(self):
819:         status = self.baseline.status
820:         return {
821:             "kind": "selection_ack",
822:             "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
823:             "request_id": self._baseline_request_id,
824:             "action": "capture_baseline",
825:             "session_id": self.session_id,
826:             "time_epoch": self.selection.time_epoch,
827:             "accepted": status == "ready",
828:             "reason": None if status == "ready" else self.baseline.reason,
829:             "track_id": self.baseline.track_id,
830:             "candidate_id": None,
831:             "selection_version": self.baseline.selection_version,
832:             "baseline": self.baseline.snapshot(),
833:             "idempotent_replay": False,
834:         }

838:     def _reject(self, request, reason):
839:         return {
840:             "kind": "selection_ack", "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
841:             "request_id": request.get("request_id"), "action": request.get("action"),
842:             "session_id": self.session_id, "time_epoch": self.selection.time_epoch,
843:             "accepted": False, "reason": reason, "track_id": None,
844:             "candidate_id": None, "selection_version": None, "baseline": None,
845:             "idempotent_replay": False}

847:     def _required_input_reason(self, receive_s):
848:         """Reason the required cloud input is currently unusable, or None."""
849:         if self._latest_valid_snapshot is None:
850:             return REASON_REQUIRED_UNAVAILABLE
851:         stream = self.cloud_timebase.streams["cloud"]
852:         if stream.stamp_status == "invalid":
853:             return stream.stamp_reason or "cloud_stamp_invalid"
854:         status, _age = stream.freshness(receive_s)
855:         if status != "fresh":
856:             return "cloud_" + status
857:         return None

859:     def _candidate_current(self, request):
860:         """True when the requested candidate has a unique current match.
861: 
862:         A select bound to an older snapshot is only allowed when the requested
863:         candidate still matches exactly one candidate in the latest valid
864:         snapshot (bounded-continuity), so a disappeared or ambiguous person is
865:         never locked from a cached position.
866:         """
867:         latest = self._latest_valid_snapshot
868:         if latest is None:
